'''Dr. Evazan Cosmetic Surgery''' was a [[Reconstructive surgery/Legends|cosmetic surgery]] clinic operated by [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]] in [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]], a small [[City/Legends|settlement]] located on the remote [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]]. The establishment was situated near the base of the [[Pons Ora water tower/Legends|Pons Ora water tower]], across the street from [[Admiral Snackbar/Legends|Admiral Snackbar]] and in close proximity to apartment [[6C/Legends|6C]].<ref name="Missing in Action" /> By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Missing in Action Date">{{FactFile2014|58|DSQ 1-2|D-Squad}}</ref> the clinic had gone out of business and the building that once housed it was available for lease.<ref name="Missing in Action" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|FOR LEASE|A sign on the clinic's window|<ref name="Missing in Action" />}}
Dr. Evazan Cosmetic Surgery first appeared in "[[Missing in Action]]," the twelfth episode of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''{{'}} [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]].<ref name="Missing in Action" />
